name: Research Skills
blurb: Find, evaluate, read and use evidence like a scholar. By the end you can build a precise search, judge a source in a minute, read a study's design and statistics critically, and cite and synthesize sources honestly and ethically.

APA and MLA Style Guides, Purdue OWL
The Belmont Report, US Department of Health and Human Services
Choosing and Using Sources: A Guide to Academic Research, Lowry, LibreTexts
